summary: Quote JSON strings by UTF-16 code-unit semantics, escaping controls, quotes, backslashes, and lone surrogates as required.

target.notes: QuoteJSONString must operate on ECMAScript UTF-16 code units. Required escapes must be emitted without locale/encoding-dependent transformations.

semantics.control_chars: use permitted JSON escapes or unicode escapes
semantics.lone_surrogate: escaped as a \uXXXX sequence to produce well-formed JSON text

caveats: Do not rely on a UTF-8 encoder that replaces lone surrogates before JSON quoting.

tests.name: quotes backslashes and controls escaped
tests.expected_behavior: result is a valid JSON string with escaped quote, backslash, and newline
